Always-on workload-fit screening: the thread CPU time and execution time of library-admitted task executions whose entry or unit is declared TaskType#COMPUTE.
The runtime measures executions admitted through an entry or unit declared TaskType#COMPUTE, comparing thread CPU time with execution time.
Low CPU use sets ParMeasurement#issue only for entries declared {@code COMPUTE} and logs one {@code WARNING} per entry.
A unit declared {@code COMPUTE} can independently set UnitMeasurement#suspectedDeclarationDrift and log one {@code INFO}; unit drift never sets the entry's issue.
Reports are created only by the library; read one with ParRuntime#workloadFitReport.
Whether the entry is declared TaskType#COMPUTE and an epoch of its executions used CPU for less than half their execution time.
Whether the unit is declared TaskType#COMPUTE and an epoch of its executions used CPU for less than half their execution time, suggesting the declaration no longer matches the execution.
Set once, for the runtime's lifetime; never sets ParMeasurement#issue.
